title: After Reverse the Bill To can be changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Net 30 credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today (no payment, deposit or credit applied), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Reverse the invoice.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
  5. Click the Bill To field.
  6. Pick customer C in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Invoiced.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 is back to Complete.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • The list opens: the field is unlocked.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
